launch_slurm_job: launch a job on SLURM using submitit with the given configuration and log directory
launch_local_job: launch a job locally with torch elastic for multi-worker or single process execution
run_slurm_spmd_program: run the SlurmSPMDProgram entrypoint for a SPMD program launched via submitit on slurm
map_job_config_to_dist_config: map a JobConfig to a distributed configuration dictionary with world size and backend settings
remove_runner_state_from_submission: remove the runner state from a submitit job submission pickle to prevent re-submission on node failure
